item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 Hasina nuclear rhetoric using multiple formulations around “nuclear rhetoric,” “apocalyptic language,” “brinkmanship,” “threat of use,” and “normalization of nuclear use.” I did not find any credible 2024 source showing Hasina personally making reckless nuclear threats or apocalyptic nuclear statements. The evidence that exists is mostly official policy posture and civilian nuclear-energy framing, which is relevant but weaker than direct quotation evidence.","evidence":[{"title":"PM urges ROSATOM to set up another nuclear power plant at Rooppur","publisher":"BSS","date":"April 2, 2024","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news-flash/181972","summary":"Hasina asked Russia’s Rosatom to consider building a second nuclear power plant and discussed technical survey work and spent-fuel return.
